newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down ahead of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down ahead of settlement.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Monday amid squaring of short positions ahead of settlement on Tuesday, dealers said.

"The index may rise on Tuesday amid short covering but sentiment would remain mixed to bearish amid lack of support from institutions," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said. The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 10.59 points, or 0.69 percent, to end at 1,526.92. Losers led gainers 194 to 62. Turnover fell to 41 million shares from 42 million in the previous session on Friday.

Adamjee Insurance rose 1.0 rupee to 102 rupees. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.40 to 33.75, PTCL 1.60 to 24.85 and Hub Power Co 0.80 to 36.90. Pakistan State Oil rose 8.0 to 300. ICI Pakistan fell 0.55 to 22.85.
